Subsequently an independently reviewed narrow cleanup freshly classified every returned role scope without modifying roles, required fourteen exact child/job IDs absent, persisted deletion intent, and performed one exact empty-group DELETE. No jobs, grants or new authentication were initiated. All failed attempts and diagnostic evidence are preserved; cleanup completion does not qualify ingestion or delivery. AUD-003 remains proposed and AUD-002/issue #1 stays separate.

No recipient delivery or deduplication was exercised. AUD-003 stays proposed: retention-rule scheduled evaluation, routing/recipient delivery and effective-permission acceptance remain open. Production Exchange/Purview and stable runtime acceptance remain separate in AUD-002/issue #1.
